rationale: Economically coherent (essentially the ΔWC + ΔNCO soft-asset half of the Richardson et al. total-accrual decomposition, deflated by gross investment), but it is largely an additive merge of two already-tested archive signals and the claim that adding ΔWC "removes the impairment-only long leg" of the intangible measure is asserted rather than argued, so incremental information is uncertain.

The hypothesis is explicitly about receivables and credit-terms loosening, but the expression computes Δ(act − che − invt), which lumps prepaids, deferred taxes and other current assets in with receivables — if a balance-sheet receivables item (rect) is available the proxy is an unnecessary and interpretation-blurring substitution, and as written the signal is close to the gen-0 archived ratio with the liability leg simply dropped.

This is a pure denominator swap on an archived signal (identical numerator, at instead of capx+dp), which is the kind of cosmetic variant the objective warns against; the FMB-versus-alpha diagnostic is a legitimate motive, but the mismatched numerator (inventory change netted against a *total* operating-liability change, not just payables) remains unaddressed and is the more likely source of the noise.

A defensible conditioner on accounting posture that is distinct from the tested change-in-rate version, but note that a persistently low dp/ppegt mechanically produces a *young*-looking (low accumulated-depreciation) capital base, making this conditioner roughly the inverse of the already-successful AccrualBloatOnAnAgingCapitalBase tilt, and dp includes intangible amortization while the denominator does not.

Internally inconsistent: the stated economics ("only the joint absence of both inputs proves the growth is not real," given capital-labor substitution) implies a conjunction operator such as MIN, whereas SUMRANK is additive and lets one sharply contracting factor dominate while the other expands — and as a blend of two already-successful archive conditioners its incremental content is modest.

The sign logic is correct and it is a genuinely useful discipline test on the family's interpretation, but it is only the liability half of the gen-0 archived numerator and the predicted positive sign is already the textbook Sloan component result, so it should be judged as a diagnostic rather than as a candidate alpha source.
